title: Find what holds Engram's store write lock past the 10 s busy budget under multi-lane load
outcome: Find what holds Engram's store write lock past the 10 s busy budget under multi-lane load
acceptance: In a bounded seven-lane reproduction on a throwaway store under target/, concurrent with one already-authorized full-gate workload, ordinary verb writes retain their existing acquisition budgets; refusals can be correlated with observed contending transaction intervals where coverage permits, and missing or ambiguous holder evidence is explicitly unavailable. Operational-store observation is passive through supported Engram diagnostics only.
A regression test or measured reproduction is recorded with the before and after numbers

completion.summary: Writer-lock holders under multi-lane load are now identified by supported diagnostics while ordinary verb writes keep their acquisition budgets; a bounded seven-lane reproduction (224 calls, 0 refusals) and the known-holder two-process measurement are recorded, with their honest limits stated. Landed at 5160c093 (ancestor of e7426a6) and verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed both criteria (record bb3d9cda9fd342269f000f561b562eca).
